text: The Arabian desert... once had hippos. And people hunting them.
A hundred twenty-five thousand years ago, this sand was a lake shore. Lake Mundafan.
Archaeologists dug up an ancient campsite there. Over five thousand stone tools.
And the bones show what was on the menu. Hippos. Ostriches. Camels. Gazelles. Buffalo.
But here's the twist. On some spear points, they found traces of a plant used for arrow poison.
No proof of a poison kill yet. But still... that's a hundred twenty-five thousand years ago.
It means Arabia wasn't just a hallway for early humans. When it rained, people lived here.
Scientists have spotted thousands of ancient lake beds across Arabia from space.
Each one could be hiding a camp like this... under the sand.
